'''Ryun''' was a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. He was killed during the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]] as he tried to reach [[Noren Rurm]]'s ship.
